question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is "decade."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The reason to use **"decade"** in the blank is that it specifies a period of time, emphasizing the duration since the thing in question (presumably a service or technology) was first offered to the public.
 
• **"Decade" **refers to a period of ten years, which fits appropriately in the context of indicating the timeframe since the service or technology was introduced. (दस वर्ष की अवधि; दशक)
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

Correct paragraph:

Alkaline hydrolysis is rare today as a funeral practice__ for humans. Offered to the public for the first time just over a __**decade**__ ago, it is now permitted and regulated in 26 U.S. states, and practiced ______ (3) ______ in North America, where it remains unfamiliar to most people who ______ (4) ______ a loved one or who are thinking about what could ______ (5) ______ to their own bodies when they die.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Vintage: **the wine that was made in a particular year. (विशेष वर्ष में तैयार की गई (अंगूरी) शराब)
 
• **Period: **a length of time. (समय की लंबाई, अवधि, मियाद)
 
• **Date: **a particular day of the month or year. (महीने या वर्ष का विशेष दिन, तिथि, दिनांक, तारीख़)
